newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Almazjuvelirexport should get PGM export licence.
newsitem.headline: Almazjuvelirexport should get PGM export licence.

text.p: Russia's Almazjuvelirexport, the state precious metals export agency, should this week receive a Foreign Trade Ministry licence for export, a Finance Ministry expert said on Tuesday.

"The Foreign Trade Ministry should award the licence this week," said Vladimir Rybkin, head of the Finance Ministry's precious metals and stones section. Receipt of a licence is a key step in Russia resuming exports of platinum and palladium to Japan.
When asked if the licencing procedure had changed and if this were a reason for Russia's delays in exporting platinum group metals this year, Rybkin said, "No.
"I consider that after this week, there will be no hindrances from our side -- but it will depend on when the contracts are signed," he said.
He declined to elaborate or to say exactly when Russia would resume deliveries of platinum and palladium to Japan, with whom it is in long-delayed contract talks.
Last week, platinum fixed at its highest level since 1990 and palladium at its highest since 1980 over worries about the delayed talks.
Russia accounts for 60 percent of the world's palladium supply and one-fifth of platinum deliveries. Japan is the biggest buyer.
